GERMANY'S HUGE ZEPPELIN HANGARS DESTROYED ON ORDER OF ALLIED COMMISSION.

The huge Zeppelin hangars which not so long ago housed the big death dealing monsters and now being destroyed at Potsdam by German workmen, under the direction of the Allied Commission for the Disarmament of Germany, Germany was first forced to dismantle her objectionableMKM, then followed the destroying of all surplice arms and war material, with the exception of a scant quantity allowed by the commission, and now follows the destruction of her air force. 11/22/21.
